title: OpenAI closes $11B first tranche at $1.25T valuation, below its earlier target
summary: OpenAI raised about $11 billion from investors including Coatue and T. Rowe Price at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the first close of a round that may reach $20 billion, after cutting its target from at least $30 billion at about $1.4 trillion.
reason: More capital to a leading lab concentrates power (F5 up), but the cut target signals investor caution; a development of the scored ~$30B round, T1.

title: Tencent's chief AI scientist warns AI biology skills near a 'can do harm' threshold
summary: Speaking in Hong Kong, Tencent chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu said AI cyber abilities already pose risks, biology capabilities will soon cross a harm threshold that may be harder to manage than cyber, and Chinese open-model releasers must take safety seriously.
reason: A senior Chinese lab leader flagging near-term bio-misuse capability is a risk signal (F8 up); words, not an incident, so T1.

title: Google DeepMind says AI found new weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
summary: DeepMind reported AI-assisted attacks on legacy 1024-bit RSA, including a theoretical ~1,600x signature-forgery efficiency gain and a padding-attack result, while stating 2048-bit and larger keys remain secure; no peer-reviewed paper yet.
reason: AI-driven cryptanalysis of deployed (if legacy) crypto shows offensive security capability (F8 up); legacy keys only and not peer reviewed, so T1.
